headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter). No Inter for headings. Keep it high-impact.

signature.usage: Used for the 'SURYA PANAV' on-load masked line-by-line reveal.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Implement a custom framer-motion cursor. Main dot follows pointer exactly. Secondary glowing orb trails behind (using glow_effect color). Add 'magnetic' snapping to buttons/links on hover.
visual_enhancers.magnetic_buttons: Use framer-motion to create magnetic buttons. The button itself moves slightly towards the cursor on hover.
visual_enhancers.smooth_scroll: Implement @studio-freight/lenis for momentum scrolling. It gives a premium 'weight' to the scroll.
visual_enhancers.tilt_cards: Use react-parallax-tilt or framer-motion for 3D tilt effects on Project cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F7]/70 border-b border-black/5. Ensure 1px inner border for clarity.

sections.header: Sticky nav (z-50, glassmorphism). Logo on left, links on right. DO NOT hide behind hamburger menu on desktop.
sections.hero: Kinetic hero. Massive typography. 'SURYA PANAV' signature with on-load masked line-by-line reveal (Framer Motion). Subtle parallax on scroll. High contrast text.
sections.about: Numbered manifesto chapters (01. Identity, 02. Vision). Asymmetrical bento layout.
sections.marquee: Slow editorial marquee separating sections. Pale background, dark earthy text. Gap-32.
sections.projects: 3D tilt cards. High-density grid (Bento A). Image max-h-[80vh] for mobile.
sections.certificates_achievements: List based or Bento grid. Use subtle roundness (max 8px). Crisp borders.
sections.skills: Floating badges or a kinetic texture background.
sections.contact: Contact form (Shadcn customized) + direct email/social links. Left-aligned inputs.
sections.footer: Massive 'Let's Talk' CTA. Quick links bar. Very generous padding (py-32). Dark footer strategy (Invert colors: Dark bg, light text).

motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion 'whileInView' or 'useInView' for stagger entrance animations.
motion.parallax: Framer motion 'useScroll' and 'useTransform' for subtle y-axis shifting on hero and images.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or max-rounded, sharp interactions. Use framer-motion for magnetic pull.
components.cards: Subtle borders (border-black/5), flat backgrounds, no heavy shadows. Lift (-translate-y-1) on hover.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-8, p-12, p-24).
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Do not use AI assistant Emoji characters. Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react.
Provide installation commands for extra libraries like framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee, react-parallax-tilt, @phosphor-icons/react.
